projects.title: App Kilometros Completa
bullets: Built a Kotlin mobile app for logging running distance, backing it with a PLpgSQL database and a TypeScript companion service.
Sustained 162 commits over 49 active days, coordinating schema changes across the mobile client and database layer alone.

projects.title: Cot Admin Next
bullets: Developed a Next.js and Tailwind CSS admin dashboard in TypeScript, structuring the React component layer for a client project.
Noticed undocumented handoffs between codebases caused repeated setup confusion, and began writing short README notes to close the gap.

leadership.title: Project Coordinator
bullets: Took ownership of merge scheduling after two peers' features silently overwrote each other, introducing a shared branching checklist.
Learned that clarifying who owned which module mattered more than writing more code, and shifted toward coordinating others' work.
